name: realized-apy
description: What an ERC-4626 dollar vault actually paid, read from public RPC. Zero dependencies, no API key. Also re-derives every row of the Kerne Honesty Index and says whether it holds.
$comment:test: Bare `node --test` discovers the suite itself. Passing a path (`node --test test/`) or a quoted glob only works from node 21 up; on node 20 and 22 it is read as a module specifier and the run dies with Cannot-find-module on the directory path. CI caught exactly that on the first push, which is what the version matrix is for. The offline suite needs no network. `test:live` hits public endpoints and is therefore not what CI gates a pull request on.
